b1-review-6.R6.1 Sunday lunch at the hostel:
Mrs. Lima: Lunch is ready, everyone! And I have a surprise: a cake made by my cousin Dora.
Bruno: A cake from the Strange Games lady? It must be strange too!
Mrs. Lima: Very funny, Bruno. Pipoca, get down! Sorry. He must have smelled the cheese bread.
Danny: He's getting faster every week. The more Bruno runs with him, the faster he gets.
Bruno: He's twice as fast as me now. It's embarrassing.
Rafa: Speaking of cheese bread... I'm still embarrassed about the bakery story. I've promised to check every message before I share it.
Mrs. Lima: Don't worry, Rafa. Mr. Nunes admitted selling more bread that day than at Christmas!
Danny: My mom called this morning and asked about the Pantanal. I told her we'd heard the monkeys screaming at five a.m. and seen a jaguar walking along the river.
Rafa: I'd been planning to go with you, but the band had a gig that weekend.
Bruno: Next time! Hey Danny, how are the seven o'clock classes going?
Danny: Much better. I get up at six now, and Ana calls me at one minute past six.
Mrs. Lima: And how many classes have you taught so far?
Danny: About a hundred and fifty. By December, I'll have taught more than two hundred.
Mrs. Lima: Ana told me Carol had a terrible week in Orlando.
Danny: Yes! There was a fire next door, someone broke into her car, and then there was an accident on the highway. She says she needs a vacation in São Paulo.
Rafa: She can come to our movie night. We watched a war film on Friday.
Mrs. Lima: Was it good?
Bruno: Too long. But Danny loved it.
Danny: It's a great film! Now, who wants some of Dora's cake?
Bruno: Me! As long as it isn't upside down.

b1-review-6.R6.3 Dialogues:
Narrator: Dialogue one.
Operator: Nine one one, what's your emergency?
Carol: I'd like to report a break-in. My neighbor's window is broken.
Operator: Is anyone hurt?
Carol: I don't think so. But there might be someone inside.
Operator: OK, ma'am. Stay outside. There'll be an officer there in ten minutes.
Narrator: Dialogue two.
Ana: You look tired. Did you sleep well?
Danny: Not really. I stayed up late watching the game, and this morning I overslept.
Ana: Who won?
Danny: We beat them two to one! It was twice as exciting as last week.
